question: What battery-life problems or benefits do iPhone 8 owners report?
answer:
One reviewer reported that the iPhone 8's Battery Health Maximum Capacity showed 82%, calling it the only disappointment. [cc940253e8f9_0]
Another reviewer said the iPhone 8 is a good phone but its battery life is low, and that it is less than their other phone they had for two years or more. [9b07710b7035_0]
One reviewer stated the iPhone 8 had a battery life of only 76 percent. [a7daeebba88d_0]
A reviewer said the only problem is that the battery life is not that long compared to newer phones. [5e7d72e6dba2_0]
One reviewer described the iPhone 8 as having horrible battery life and being a waste of money. [adfa7cfff851_0]
In contrast, another reviewer reported great battery life, saying it was as good as new and nearly as long as the original iPhone 8. [52a425788215_0]

Fine shape. My concerns when purchasing a refurbished or renewed iPhone would be: - is it what I ordered? Yes, an iPhone 8 with 64 GB. - Are there scratches on the shell? No. Some scratches would have been acceptable, since I would put the phone in a case anyway. - Are there scratches on the glass? No, in fact the phone had a protective film installed (probably by the original owner). - Is the battery in good shape? Sort of. Battery Health, Maximum Capacity reports 82%. That's the only disappointment. I imagine that battery health will vary.
